property.name: configName
property.label: Check Set Developer Name
property.description: Developer name of the Record_Health_Check_Set__mdt record to run (e.g. Account_Data_Quality).

property.name: comparisonDisclosure
property.label: Comparison Disclosure
property.description: Initial state of the per-row comparison caret for this placement. Inherit = follow the Check Set (collapsed). Collapsed = start collapsed. Expanded = pre-open the detail on rows that have a caret. Cannot reveal detail the Check Set's Comparison Display does not allow.
